name: piano-helper
description: Piano Helper — local adult piano studio

scripts.studio: npm run build:app && npm run piano-helper -- studio
scripts.build: npm run build -w @piano-helper/shared && npm run build -w @piano-helper/starters && npm run build -w @piano-helper/bridge && npm run build -w @piano-helper/desktop && npm run build -w @piano-helper/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @piano-helper/shared && npm run test -w @piano-helper/bridge
